scope: Read-only workflow review; no production or runner modifications, no jobs launched or stopped. This JSON is the sole audit output.

findings.condition: A route exits without result.json after writing route/utilization.rpt, while its functional validation passes; likewise a missing baseline result with an existing route report.
findings.effect: choose() appends an ineligibility reason but still computes ratios and accesses result[wns_ns] / old_route[wns_ns], causing TypeError and preventing final report/selection/cleanup.
findings.minimal_fix: Skip ratio computation for a backend immediately after recording missing/illegal routed comparison, while retaining the rejection reason.

selection_review.cases_interface: PASS: reads SUMMARY.cases, not supplementary tests, and extracts focus profile/sign cycles.
selection_review.workload: PASS: every normal case compares hashes and physical_blocks with a same-validator baseline.
selection_review.legal_route: PASS for candidates: requires exit 0, full routing, no route errors, DRC 0 and nonnegative hold before eligibility.
selection_review.closed_baseline: PASS: closed baseline must retain strict accepted_frequency at 100 MHz.
selection_review.unclosed_baseline: PASS: candidate WNS cannot worsen; routed-area x measured-cycle ratios are explicitly labeled hypothetical at assumed 100 MHz.
selection_review.focus: PASS: all three focus ratios in every affected backend must be <= 1 and at least one ratio must be < 1.
selection_review.area_scope: PASS: selection parses corresponding route/utilization.rpt with main matrix BRAM/DSP-weighted equivalent Slice formula; unused route_area helper points to synth reports but is not used in selection.
selection_review.deployment: PASS: selected production design RTL hashes are checked against original frozen source before any copies; external modification blocks deployment.

cleanup_review.authorization: User explicitly authorized removal of the temporary worktree after verified preservation and measurement-based migration; git worktree remove --force is within that request.
cleanup_review.active_guard: PASS: checks /proc numeric entries for cwd in temporary root or command arguments containing its absolute path; any hit retains worktree. Conservative substring matches can safely defer cleanup.
cleanup_review.review_note: Guard covers explicit cwd/argument dependencies; it does not enumerate open file descriptors. Index hash is preserved in evidence but cleanup rechecks exact status, HEAD and working-file checksums rather than the index bytes. No current mismatch observed.
cleanup_review.failed_preconditions: PASS: unresolved preservation, changed status/HEAD/files or an active process retain the temporary worktree.

lifecycle_review.completion: Normal completion chooses, cleans up, publishes complete=true, then exits with no persistent refresh loop.
lifecycle_review.robustness_note: Unexpected worker/JSON exceptions can terminate the controller before final publish; normal command failures are handled and remain ineligible. Missing-result selection edge is separately reported.

recommendation: Keep measurements running. Correct the missing/illegal-result early-continue in future runner use. The current detached Python process already loaded its functions, so editing the file does not hot-update its choose() method. If the edge case occurs, finalize from preserved STATE/results with a corrected postprocessor without rerunning Vivado.
runner_difference: Only prepare() archive ignore_patterns differs: workspace additionally omits validation directories and *.log; running measurement/selection/cleanup code is identical.
